abstract: The expression of a high molecular weight cell surface glycoprotein (LETS, fibronectin) by preimplantation mouse embryos as well as cultured teratocarcinoma stem cells was detected by using indirect immunofluorescent staining. When each stage of preimplantation embryonic development was tested for the presence of LETS protein, none was observed on two-cell, four-cell, or eight-cell embryos, or on the morula or the outer cell layer (trophectoderm) of the early or late blastocyst. However, when the inner cell mass was isolated by immunosurgery, positive staining was observed. The intensity of the staining was significantly greater on the inner cell mass isolated from the expanded (day 4) blastocyst than on that from the early (day 3) blastocyst. Certain established cell lines of teratocarcinoma stem cells (embryonal carcinoma cells) also express cell surface LETS protein. "Nullipotent" (Nulli-SCC-1) as well as pluripotent (PSA 1) embryonal carcinoma cell lines have deposits of LETS protein concentrated in areas of cell-cell contact. In addition, a teratocarcinoma-derived endodermal cell line (PYS) was found to be capable of depositing LETS onto the substratum in a fibrillar network.Taken together, our results indicate that LETS protein is synthesized at a specific stage of preimplantation mouse embryonic development. In particular, they suggest that LETS protein is a product of the embryonic ectoderm, and that some types of embryonic endoderm are also capable of synthesizing this protein.
abstract_ja: LETS（フィブロネクチン）と呼ばれる高分子量細胞表面糖タンパク質の発現を、間接免疫蛍光染色を用いて、着床前マウス胚と培養した奇形癌幹細胞で検出した。着床前胚の各発生段階を検査したところ、2細胞期、4細胞期、8細胞期、桑実胚、および初期・後期胚盤胞の外層（栄養外胚葉）のいずれにも発現は認められなかった。しかし、免疫外科処理で単離した内部細胞塊では陽性染色が得られた。染色強度は初期（3日目）胚盤胞より拡張（4日目）胚盤胞から単離した内部細胞塊で有意に強かった。確立された奇形癌幹細胞株（胎児性癌細胞）の一部も、細胞表面にLETSタンパク質を発現している。非全能性（Nulli-SCC-1）および多能性（PSA 1）の胎児性癌細胞株はいずれも、細胞間接触部に集中したLETSタンパク質の沈着を示す。さらに、奇形癌由来の内胚葉細胞株（PYS）は、LETSを基質上に線維状ネットワークとして沈着させることができた。以上の結果は、LETSタンパク質がマウス着床前胚発生の特定の段階で合成されることを示している。特に、LETSタンパク質は胚性外胚葉の産物であり、胚性内胚葉の一部もこのタンパク質を合成できることを示唆している。
